scope: Five assigned assets; each original marketing WEBP and four original desktop/mobile closed/open PNGs inspected individually with vision. No boards substituted. Art unchanged.

verdict_meanings.pass: No material visual blocker identified in these views; caveats remain. Not final approval.
verdict_meanings.needs-decision: A visual presentation or promotional-fidelity concern requires an art-direction decision; not a proven geometry failure.

limitations: Runtime checks were supplied as passing context, not rerun or treated as visual approval.
Static views cannot establish continuous collision clearance, mechanical functionality, hidden surfaces or physical-phone performance.
Readmes describe desktop-GPU mobile emulation, stylized procedural assets and sampled mechanical checks, not photorealism or engineering certification.
Closed-view hidden hinges and open-view disengaged latches are not failures by themselves. Lid-top ornaments are occluded behind the raised lid in front open views, not proven missing.

Small hardware contacts, cavity floors and fine terrain features are partly occluded or too small for definitive inspection. Promotional shading/detail differences are not automatically geometry defects.
No root source_readme.md existed; the five per-ID sources/<id>/source_readme.md files were located and read instead.

findings.hardware: Warm brass clasp, round front disc, left ring and lid corner caps remain recognizable across promotional and runtime closed views. Open views show two rear hinges and the released lid-mounted tab. No clear detached fitting or gross break is evidenced.
findings.terrain: Pale separate rectangular floes and blue leads are readable. Rear upright blocks read partly architectural. Promo gives these blocks frosted/translucent ice-like depth; runtime reads as opaque pale blocks, consistent with the README's enamel/porcelain limitation. Small enclosed ponds are not clearly distinguished at mobile size.
findings.texture: Promo has richer frosted mottling and subtler body tracery. Runtime pale line motifs repeat conspicuously; desktop front has straight-bounded tonal/pattern discontinuities, and corner transitions are abrupt. These are visible surface-treatment concerns, not proof of broken mesh or an unintended UV error.
findings.mobile_observations: Closed ice silhouette and main clasp remain readable; fine ponds and seating contacts do not. Both mobile states fit fully without visible clipping or controls overlapping the model.
findings.open_observations: Flat teal inner lid, blue lined cavity, rim and rear hinges are visible. Full raised silhouette and projecting tab are framed. Lower cavity remains partly hidden; terrain is on the opposite lid face.
findings.promotional_finish_vs_geometry: Primary mismatch is icy/translucent promotional finish versus opaque stylized runtime shading, plus conspicuous runtime body repetition. No unequivocal geometry defect established.
findings.decision_needed: Decide whether the promotional ice treatment overstates the intended porcelain-like runtime appearance and whether the front texture discontinuities are acceptable decorative panel treatment.
limitations: No alternate rear/top inspection or animation examined.
Cannot infer transparent materials or exact attachment quality from promo highlights alone.

findings.hardware: Brass front clasp, corner caps and inset edging are coherent across promo/runtime. Two rear hinges and released tab appear in open views. Tiny shell seating details are difficult to resolve, but no clear unattached or broken component is visible.
findings.terrain: No landscape terrain is intended. Pearl-bearing shell on teal inset reads clearly; regular fan ribs look scallop-like rather than a biologically accurate oyster, as disclosed in the README. Pearl is readable as a glossy white sphere.
findings.texture: Cream cloudy stone, teal inset and brass palette carry through. Promo is more softly polished with a paler blue-gray inset; runtime is more saturated teal and simplified. Fine porosity and nacre are not strongly resolved.
findings.mobile_observations: Shell/pearl silhouette survives downscaling, while lower shell and tiny brass cradle details merge. Main clasp remains legible. Both states fully framed; fine secondary UI text is small.
findings.open_observations: Plain pale underside, teal rim, empty-looking recessed cavity and rear hinges are visible. No gross cavity intrusion or surface break apparent. Pearl is occluded on opposite lid face, not missing.
findings.promotional_finish_vs_geometry: Differences are predominantly lighting, saturation and material polish. Strong teal closed seam is present as a design band; it does not establish an unclosed lid or geometry defect.
limitations: Shell attachment contacts and pearl microfinish cannot be verified at screenshot scale.
Cavity depth and full hinge motion remain unverified by stills.

findings.hardware: Brass corner caps, long front clasp, round disc and left ring are consistent visible features. Pale irregular stone-like feet remain present. Open views expose rear hinges and released tab; no demonstrated broken hardware.
findings.terrain: Blue inset with pale polygon loops and small ochre relief retains the Uyuni concept. Promo presents more strongly raised, regular lattice-like crust; runtime lines are finer and flatter-looking at default scale. Ochre relief is faceted and mound-like rather than geographically specific.
findings.texture: White horizontal body courses read as planks or ceramic/masonry more readily than crystalline salt in both treatments, consistent with README. Promo gives feet and crust stronger granular detail; runtime pale surfaces are smoother and lower contrast.
findings.mobile_observations: Ochre peak and blue lid remain recognizable, but salt polygon relief becomes faint. Main clasp is readable; fine fittings merge. Full closed and open silhouettes fit without clipping.
findings.open_observations: Broad plain white underside and pale cavity are visible with blue-gray rim. Low contrast weakens wall/floor separation; no obvious intrusion or break. Landscape is hidden behind lid, not proven absent.
findings.promotional_finish_vs_geometry: Raised promotional salt lattice versus fine runtime lines is a relief/readability mismatch, not sufficient evidence that runtime geometry is absent. Readme reports physical loops; stills do not independently verify their depth.
findings.decision_needed: Decide whether the subtler runtime salt crust and plank-like body meet the visual promise of the more granular, strongly raised promo treatment.
limitations: No close-up or alternate light to distinguish shallow physical relief from shading.
Pale interior depth and tiny mounting contacts cannot be established precisely.

findings.hardware: Brass long clasp, front disc, left ring and corner fittings remain recognizable; open captures show rear hinges and released tab. Front disc's function is not visually obvious but it is not evidence of a detached part. No gross hardware break established.
findings.terrain: Volcanic cone and lower ridges carry through. Promo exposes a clearer crater opening and textured interior; default runtime angle emphasizes the peak, leaving crater depth and horseshoe caldera opening difficult to read, especially on mobile. This is a readability issue, not proof of a flat or missing crater.
findings.texture: Mottled gray/brown stone with rust/ash bands persists. Promo is more granular and dimensional; runtime mottling can read cloudy concrete, while broad terrain color patches look applied/procedural. These align with disclosed stylization limitations.
findings.mobile_observations: Volcanic silhouette and brass clasp read clearly, but caldera basin/opening and symbolic cultivated details do not. Texture becomes muddy at this scale. Both states are fully framed.
findings.open_observations: Stone underside, dark cavity, blue rim and rear hinges are visible. Dark interior limits floor/depth inspection. Terrain is concealed on opposite lid face. Projecting released latch remains within frame.
findings.promotional_finish_vs_geometry: Concern is weaker runtime recognition of the named caldera and crater compared with promo. README describes a tested recess and opening; this review neither independently confirms nor contradicts those geometry measurements.
findings.decision_needed: Decide whether default desktop/mobile crater visibility is adequate for the Atlantic Caldera identity or whether presentation/art needs refinement before acceptance.
limitations: A higher or rear camera would be needed to evaluate the caldera opening directly.
No continuous motion or fine hardware contact inspection performed.

findings.hardware: Brass front clasp, round disc, left ring and corner caps retain the family layout across promo/runtime. Irregular gray supports remain visible. Open rear hinges and released tab are recognizable; no unambiguous broken or floating part established.
findings.terrain: Low green cultivated hills, repeated shrub clusters and cream farmhouse with terracotta roof retain the same concept. Low rolling relief is not a dramatic mountain skyline, as disclosed. House is a useful scale cue; coffee species relies on title/context.
findings.texture: Honey bamboo-like vertical strips with conspicuously repeated scalloped nodes appear in both promo and runtime. Pattern reads stamped/ribbed rather than natural bamboo; this is a shared stylization caveat, not a new runtime defect. Promo adds softer lighting, rougher feet and richer material detail.
findings.mobile_observations: House silhouette, hill and plant rows remain visible; shrubs can read bead-like and tiny architectural details disappear. Main latch remains legible. No closed/open silhouette clipping or model/control overlap evident.
findings.open_observations: Bamboo-patterned underside and inner walls, green rim, cavity and hinges are visible. Front wall obscures part of lower interior; top landscape is occluded behind raised lid. Complete open silhouette fits.
findings.promotional_finish_vs_geometry: Core composition, palette and hardware agree; differences are mostly lighting and polished promotional finish. Repetition and schematic terrain are disclosed artistic limits rather than evidenced geometry failures.
limitations: Small farmhouse details and coffee identity cannot be independently established from mobile view.
Static front views cannot certify hidden landscape attachment or full cavity depth.
